# The build venv's tooling, pinned by version and by content (ticket 25).
#
# Every source archive the build compiles is pinned by its SHA-256 (spec §10);
# this is the other half of what a run downloads. Nothing here is a
# supply-chain hole of the kind the digests closed — pip verifies what it
# downloads against PyPI's own hashes — what it buys is reproducibility: two
# runs of the same commit, a month apart, install the same tooling, and the
# two variants of one release are built by the same tooling by construction
# rather than by both jobs happening to resolve on the same day.
#
# Four of these are not build-only in the way the rest are. auditwheel rewrites
# sonames and grafts libraries into the payload, and abi3audit --strict is the
# only thing standing behind the abi3 tag: a changed release of either changes
# the artefact or the strength of the claim. numpy and mpi4py are compiled and
# imported against — petsc4py's and slepc4py's extensions take their headers
# from this numpy, and the import check runs against this mpi4py.
#
# Regenerate after editing wheelbuild/requirements.in:
#
#   uv pip compile --generate-hashes --no-header \
#     --python-version 3.12 --python-platform x86_64-manylinux_2_34 \
#     wheelbuild/requirements.in -o wheelbuild/requirements.txt
#
# and put this header back on top. The interpreter and platform are the build
# container's — manylinux_2_34_x86_64 on the cp312 that the abi3 wheel targets
# (scripts/build-wheel.sh's PYTHON default) — because a resolution made for
# anything else would install a different set of wheels there.
#
# scripts/build-wheel.sh installs this with --require-hashes, which is also
# what makes pip refuse a requirement that is not pinned here: the file has to
# be complete, transitive dependencies and all. The three requirements that
# are deliberately absent come out of drivers at run time and are installed by
# their own pip lines — see wheelbuild/requirements.in for which and why.
abi3audit==0.0.26 \
    --hash=sha256:44b5fa5ddc8acdfdbd221f400d48b8a205df519e8f4c6d57a349837ac88d0ff8 \
    --hash=sha256:b94b774984e50ec03481c1dda88c48079f6baec870b263bf7f5e7415feb8802d
    # via -r wheelbuild/requirements.in

    --hash=sha256:dd96754872211f96ed6955d47e725bdc579e581dd1705d581923270f825d1318
    # via abi3audit

    --hash=sha256:d03ceb89cb322a8fd706d4fb91940737b6642aa36998fe130a9bc96c985eff32
    # via
    #   cattrs
    #   requests-cache

    # via -r wheelbuild/requirements.in
